text_block_list.text:
—Hokko Tarumae has successfully set a
"historic record" with the most Dirt G1
victories in history.
One day, while the excitement praising her great achievement had still not cooled down—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
can I open my eyes now?
choice_data_list: Hold on a second......... All right, okay!
Hold on a second......... Yep, okay!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is going on?
Doing something like this during a meeting—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae! Congrats on setting the all-time record for most GⅠ wins~!”

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fans
text_block_list.text: Congrats~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what? Whaaaat!?
Wh-What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Surpri~se☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A surprise...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Wasn't today supposed to be the on-stage meeting for the talk session with Falco-san—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
That was actually a lie!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just a little something to give Tarumae-chan a surprise, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Not just Falco-san, but Acute-san too...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't worry, we really will do
the talk session and prep meeting next time♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was tough, you know~ Keeping it a secret
from Tarumae-chan until today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: To make up for tricking you, please let us celebrate you all you want today!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae~!! Congrats on your historic achievement~~!!
You're the coolest ever~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Please lead the future of dirt racing~~!!
I'll always be cheering for youuu~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The real deal starts now!
Now, Tarumae, go take a seat with your Trainer at the head table over there☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Today, we're going to put on a special stage just for you, Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wanna celebrate Tarumae-chan for trying her absolute best
and firing us all up so much!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go!
The song I wrote just for today—
"DEAR MY RIVAL!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
DEAR MY RIVAL!
Because you were here for me—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
DEAR MY RIVAL!
Because I ran alongside you—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm standing right here now♪
And I'll live up to this miracle♪”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
DEAR MY RIVAL!
Thank you, for everything up until now and everything to come—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, and finally,
a word from Tarumae's Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, Tarumae, are you still crying?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... O-Of course I do......!
Because...... this is just unfair......!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then here's a follow-up blow from the Trainer!
Bring out that thing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-Is there still something else...?
choice_data_list: This is from Tomakomai and all your fans.

text_block_list.text:
In front of Hokko Tarumae,
I laid out what I had prepared in advance.

It read 'Congratulations on achieving the most GⅠ wins in history!'
and depicted Hokko Tarumae standing majestically in a paddock with raging waves—

It was a magnificent "bountiful catch flag,"
serving as a vivid reminder that her hometown is a port town!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! Big catch flags...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Rickey.
...Acute-san.
...Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Dear fans.
...Everyone back in Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so incredibly happy...!
So please let me say it here, one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae won't be satisfied with this record...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The star that you all helped shine
will shine even more dazzlingly from now on!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's why—
I look forward to working with you from here on out, too!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

Adding that glory to the brilliance of her wings,
Hokko Tarumae's challenge continues—
